meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过原生适配器连接 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直接集成 WhatsApp 消息通道而不依赖第三方 SDK
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via native adapter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate WhatsApp messaging directly without third-party SDK

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 WhatsApp 收发消息、文件、表情反应，并显示打字状态。支持群聊和私聊，使用二维码或配对码连接手机。
howto.when: 当用户运行 /setup 流程或手动执行安装步骤时触发。需要先完成文件复制、依赖安装和手机认证。

say.text: 帮我通过 WhatsApp 发送一条消息给张三。
在 WhatsApp 群里回复刚才那条消息。
say.note: Claude 会找到对应群组并回复。

say.text: 把这张图片通过 WhatsApp 发给我。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages, files, emoji reactions, and typing indicators via WhatsApp. Supports group chats and DMs. Uses QR code or pairing code for phone authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs the /setup flow or manually executes the installation steps. Requires file copying, dependency installation, and phone authentication.

say_en.text: Send a WhatsApp message to John.
say_en.note: Claude will use the connected WhatsApp account.

say_en.text: Reply to that message in the WhatsApp group.
say_en.note: Claude will find the group and reply.

say_en.text: Send this image to me via WhatsApp.
say_en.note: Claude will send the image attachment.
